verdict.rationale: No evidence pack item documents per-second or per-minute billing granularity; pricing pages only mention 'save up to 70%' and 'cancel anytime' without specifying billing increments, and the one community data point references an 'hourly rate' rather than sub-minute billing. Auto-shutdown (docs-5) shows machines can be stopped after inactivity but doesn't establish fine-grained metered billing while running.
